question: Does the Hetzner Inference API token-minting page at https://experiments.hetzner.com/inference require a card or an ID check beyond a Hetzner account login, and is the free service still live after its stated 8 December 2026 end date?
why: The free status, end date and rate limits are quoted from Hetzner's own documentation read on 2026-11-24, but the token-creation gate is a client-rendered application behind a sign-up that this lane did not open. compute/hetzner-inference-api records the visible email/account gate and leaves the rest unverified.
